gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-epunda-slab: Neon-tube letters with a wide-open grin: Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width from start to finish. And Epunda Slab, a serif with tall rounded lowercase and a gaping c, gives that looseness a sturdy, dignified partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, a tall middle band under shallow ascenders. Shantell Sans loops along like thin plastic tubing up top, so the text below can settle into easy, unhurried reading paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kadwa: Shantell Sans runs uninterrupted monoline strokes, loose and expressive. Kadwa's classic serif curves are open-ended and its large x-height keeps reading smooth, line after line, without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noticia-text: A mouth as wide as a tin can's cut lid defines Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib. Noticia Text brings classic serif curves with big entrances and a literary, dignified counterweight.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-piazzolla: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, one-nib looseness to the top of the page. And Piazzolla, a serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, does the steady, authoritative work below.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-suwannaphum: Loose, loopy, unmistakable: Shantell Sans has no swelling where curves meet stems, just one fixed nib. Suwannaphum, a serif with a high x-height, reads dignified and steady across paragraphs.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-fs-karma: Karma is classic serif through and through, its terminals finishing well away from the stem beneath the bold Sirin Stencil. Its gentle modulation never snags, so reading glides along.
gen-gf-slackey-fs-karma: Slackey is a tall, sturdy display face, full of long pauses between its letters. Karma takes the quiet, trustworthy work, its text serif modulation never snagging the eye.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-fauna-one: Commanding without shouting, Sniglet runs terminals that stop short of curling back in. Fauna One keeps reading literary and unhurried, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders easy on the eye.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-scope-one: Scope One brings classic serif counters that spill into surrounding space, with stubby ascenders under the Sniglet heading. Its big x-height means the body size can stay quite modest.
